description: HodgeCY v1.0.0 is the first comprehensive HodgeCY data-system release. It provides source-aware computational Hodge and Calabi--Yau corpus infrastructure, typed dataset schemas, catalog and query tooling, provenance and checksum tracking, relationship infrastructure, basis-aware exact algebra support, certificate/reproducibility support, and public documentation for an audited external corpus containing 574,616,978 headline source/data records across 53 logical datasets, 80 dataset/source instances, 187 physical sources, and 32 query tables. Large third-party scientific data remain external and retain their original licenses and terms.
notes: No v1.0.0 DOI is declared in this repository metadata before Zenodo mints one. The historical HodgeCY I / v0.2.0 archived software DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.21429481 and remains a related earlier research output, not the v1.0.0 DOI.
title: HodgeCY: A Computational Hodge and Calabi--Yau Data System
